name: Madlib
hook: A California producer who made most of Madvillainy in a Brazilian hotel room on a small sampler, and who traded beats by post with J Dilla.
blurb: Otis Jackson Jr. grew up in Oxnard, California, the son of musicians. As Madlib he makes beats from obscure records: jazz, soul, Brazilian music, film soundtracks. He is the clearest example on the map of the producer as the author of a record, and of small gear making major records. He made most of the music for Madvillainy, his 2004 album with MF DOOM, on a trip to Brazil, in his hotel room, using a small portable Boss SP-303 sampler, a turntable and a tape deck. With J Dilla he made the album Champion Sound (2003) as Jaylib, each of them rapping over the other's beats in different cities. Both records came out on Stones Throw, and they link Detroit's new ideas about rhythm to the West Coast's record digging.
